sc: The Third Age-dyed augmented drygore longsword is a level 90 Melee main hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a drygore longsword (third age), or by using third age dye on an augmented drygore longsword.

Barbarian assault ticket - hard wave 6.x: The Barbarian assault ticket - hard wave 6 is an item that is obtained from Captain Cain or Commander Connad by requesting to change your current wave in hard-mode Barbarian Assault from wave six back to wave one, or attempting to enter the wave one lobby.

sc: It can be obtained as a Treasure Trail reward or purchased from either another player or from the Grand Exchange.
It cannot be made using the Crafting skill.
It can be earned by obtaining 900 potential on a bounty emblem (t5), and can be upgraded to a bounty emblem (t7) by earning another 1200 potential.
A Bowl of blue glaze was made by using a vial of blue glaze on an empty bowl during the 2010 Easter event.

p: South-western building of Marigold Farm in Havenhythe
sc: A bowl of water is made by using a normal bowl on a water source.
There are two spawns: one in the house inside the Desert Mining Camp and another in the southwestern building of Marigold Farm in Havenhythe.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 16 elder rune bars and elder rune armoured boots + 4, requiring 1,600 progress to complete, granting a total of 16,000 Smithing experience.
They are created by using a bronze track 60% or a bronze joint on an anvil with the other in the inventory, requiring 9 Smithing and giving 9 experience.
Brutish dinosaurs are brutish dinosaurs that can be obtained from checking a brutish dinosaur (unchecked) or through breeding any type of brutish dinosaur.
Unchecked brutish dinosaurs can be obtained from killing brutish dinosaurs, or from purchasing a dinosaur egg from the Hunter Mark Shop.
Players can obtain this item either by trading with another player, or by receiving it as a very rare drop from killing Revenants or the Chaos Elemental.
The Cadarn off-hand crossbow is a cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing task 37 of the Yak to the Light event.

Chaos Witch robe top.x: Chaos Witch robe top is a torso slot cosmetic override. It is unlocked by alongside the rest of the Chaos Witch outfit by completing the Conqueror of Chaos achievement.

sc: Cherry Blossom Wand is a main hand magic weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by claiming a cherry blossom wand token.
Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.

Clue scroll (hard) - Four blades I have,.x: Clue scroll (hard) is a cryptic clue obtained from hard sealed clue scrolls. It contains a clue to solve Treasure Trails.

sc: A combat lamp is a quest item rewarded for completing Contact!.
If the lamp is destroyed, a player can obtain a replacement lamp from the High Priest in Sophanem.
Commander gloves are an item that can be purchased from Stanley Limelight Traders for 30 thaler.

The commander gloves were formerly purchased from Commander Loman on the of the Mobilising Armies office tower by spending 74,600 reward points earned from playing the minigame alongside having a 100+ rank within the minigame.
Cosmic Ordering can be obtained from the excavation hotspots at the Orthen - Observation outpost excavation site.
The devices created by Skeka and her team to "collect and focus ambient power for localised uses" appear to reference the Cosmic Accumulator and its components.
It is made by firing a cracked runecrafting urn (unf) in a pottery oven or at a portable crafter, requiring level 4 Crafting and giving 18 Crafting experience.
Croesus flakes are dropped by Croesus, and are used as secondary ingredients in creating rewards from the Croesus Front.
The demonic title scroll (terrifying) is a scroll dropped by the demon boss in a Demon Flash Mob.
Dominion mines are a reward that can be purchased after killing 400 quest bosses and finishing all special challenges, with the exception of Sunfreet, within the Dominion Tower.
Each mine costs 1,000 coins, with 10 mines purchased at a time from the Strange face.
The dragonstone bracelet is made by using a gold bar, a cut dragonstone, and a bracelet mould on a furnace.
Currently, the cost of a full repair using chitin scraps if purchased from the Grand Exchange would be .
The ectorobe top is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.

tx: The elder rune burial longsword requires 1,600 progress to finish.
The elder wood box must be created using elder logs; protean logs can't be used.

Elf-style dress top (blue).x: The blue elf-style dress top is part of the elven outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Elite black armour set.x: Elite black armour set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items from elite black armour with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: It is made by dyeing an elite sirenic mask with an ice dye.
It may also be created by upgrading a new sirenic mask (ice).
It is made by ensouling salve cloth at the Daemonheim ritual site with level 1 Necromancy, and it can be used to make deathsalve armour, a tier 1 set of necromancy armour.
The Equilibrium rune trophy is a reward from Equilibrium League.
It is earned at 35,000 League points and is awarded to the nominated account at the end of the league.

It can be screened at level 20 Archaeology to obtain materials and rarely artefacts from it at the screening station at the Archaeology Campus.
It is found in the food barrel.
A Fremennik skirt can be bought from Yrsa's Clothing Shop in Rellekka after completing The Fremennik Trials.

s: Accessed via frozen or warped token
sc: A Frozen Basic Attack (Necromancy) cosmetic ability scroll is an item that can be redeemed to unlock the Frozen Basic Attack (Necromancy) override.
It can be purchased from the Smuggled Goods shop for 3 frozen tokens.

sc: The glacial siren is a cosmetic override outfit that can be purchased for 6 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 25 of The Knight Before Christmas while having access to premier rewards and was later available for a time from the Marketplace for oddments.
A green charm slice is an item that can be obtained from hunting charm sprites.

Group Ironman helm 1.x: Group Ironman helm 1 is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Group Ironman armour 1.

sc: Heffy is a companion pet that can be purchased for 5 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 35 of Yak to the Light with a premier pass.
A hermit crab coral is a home for the hermit crab pet, and can be bought from Mhistyll's Prifddinas Waterfall Fishing Shop for 1,500 crystal urchin points.
Karamthulhu are a squid-like species that are sometimes obtained while fishing for slugs during the Rum Deal quest.
They are also dropped by zombie pirates and zombie swabs.
A Kethsi outfit scroll is a rare drop from elite rune dragons that can be used to unlock a piece of the Kethsi outfit override.
The Slayer collection log entry will unlock upon reading the scroll, even if not obtained as a drop.
A large XP lamp can be bought from Aris' Reward Shop for five silver pennies, which are rewarded after completing or replaying Dimension of Disaster.
The Lucky Bandos helmet is a piece of lucky equipment that can be won from Treasure Hunter.

Luna's compass.x: Luna's compass is an item used in the 2021 Halloween event. Using its track option, it'll lead the player to spots to dig up the discarded sword hilt and blade.

Lunarlight Greatsword.x: The Lunarlight Greatsword is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be obtained by purchasing the Lunarlight Weapon bundle.

sc: A Manuscript of Ful can be obtained as a reward from defeating TzKal-Zuk in the Elder God Wars Dungeon, or as a reward from opening Elder Troves of Ful.

It is made by combining 1 dinosaur leather, 1 masterwork thread, and 8 of each of black dragon leather, royal dragon leather, and undead dragon leather, which requires level 110 Crafting (this is done anywhere by selecting 'Craft' on any of the constituent items).
A medium XP lamp (Slayer) is a fairly common prize from Treasure Hunter.
While the hood is bought with the skillcape, it is not needed to perform the emote associated with it; the skillcape is the only essential item.

Musketeer's trousers (blue, male).x: The blue musketeer’s trousers are part of the musketeer outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

sc: Nefthys' tooth is a pet unlock item which may be obtained by defeating Nakatra, Devourer Eternal at the Sanctum of Rebirth.
The NovtumberFest Beer Goggles are a cosmetic override head unlocked by using a Beer goggles token.
They may be created by adding feathers to rune dart tips - 10 rune darts will be made at a time giving 18.

r: Partial completion of Dealing with Scabaras
sc: It can be made by using a bucket of Ugthanki dung on a bronze full helm while standing in the Kharidian Desert.
The Pastkeeper's tapestry is a relic received after completing the Dragonkin VI collection for the first time.
The Phasmatys flag can be purchased from Honest Jimmy for 600 Pieces of Eight.
Purple pirate shirts can be looted from pirate implings.
Potent herbs (also called Spirit points) are the reward currency of Herby Werby.
Up to 100 can be earned per completion of the activity, which resets weekly.

sc: Prestigious Solak-o'-lantern spoils are items rewarded from completing the Solak-o'-lantern encounter in the Maize Maze.
The primal knife is a main hand Ranged item found in Daemonheim.
It is only obtainable as a drop from Icy Bones.

r: Partial completion of Elemental Workshop II
sc: Primed bars may be made by processing an elemental bar in level 2 of the Elemental Workshop.
It is received when the player teleports with the timeworn lodestone.
The Replica statue piece is an item rewarded for completing the Statue of Dahmaroc.
Replica statue pieces are obtained in a specific order, and each one resembles a normal strange rock.
The reward casket is an item obtained by solving both Closure's clue scrolls after completing Once Upon a Time in Gielinor.
It can be purchased from Marmaros the rewards trader for 1,000,000 dungeoneering tokens ( with the warped gorajan trailblazer outfit) and 1 warped stone, and comes with its off-hand variant.
The savage plume is one of four parts of Laniakea's spear that is dropped by the Rex Matriarchs.
The shadow diamond is one of the four Diamonds of Azzanadra which must be obtained during the Desert Treasure quest.
It is located in the Shadow Dungeon and is obtained by killing both of Damis' forms.

s: Burthorpe; can be accessed via Shadow Gem shard
sc: Shadow Gem Pernix Boots is a cosmetic feet override that can be purchased for 3 Shadow Gem shards from the Shadow Gem Shop.
The Shadow Gem shards can be earned by spending Treasure Hunter keys during the Crystal Capsules promotion.
Shoes (male, shoes) is obtained from the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion.
Upon receiving a piece from the ringmaster, it becomes available as a cosmetic override in the Customisation interface.
There are four types of shoes which may be awarded to players.

Silken Boots (override).x: The Silken Boots are a feet slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Silken outfit. They are the override equivalent of the Silken boots item.

sc: The skill card deck was a promotional item won from Treasure Hunter between 29 August 2014 and 9 September.
If you did not have a deck, one was created when you won a card.
It has tier 80 stats, and is obtained by upgrading a tier 70 variant after the completion of Kili's Knowledge VI or Kili's Knowledge VI (power).
It can now be bought for 10,000 oddments from the Marketplace on a rotational basis.

s: Ani's Seed Store by the Sea Shore
sc: These seeds may be obtained by planting a fireberry seed and a mournberry seed next to each other and foraging from one of the resulting bushes, or by foraging from a sourberry bush.
They are obtained from the Juggling Equipment box, next to the Agility assistant.
They are crafted from starbloom cloth using the tailoring process, granting a total of 2,640 Crafting experience.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 steel bars, requiring 600 progress to complete, granting a total of 150 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like small bladed steel salvage by the spring cleaner.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 steel bars and a steel off hand sword, requiring 480 progress to complete, granting a total of 150 Smithing experience.
Symbol of Devotion token is an unlock token that may be awarded from Santa's Christmas Presents starting in 2025.
The team-36 cape is a wilderness cape that can be purchased for 50 coins from Richard.
The team-43 cape is a wilderness cape that can be purchased for 50 coins from Larry.
The Threads of Fate is a relic created by combining a fully repaired giant pouch with the abyssal thread, obtained after completing the Zamorakian I collection.

Tribal Top (override).x: The Tribal Top is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Tribal outfit. It is the override equivalent of the Tribal shirt and Tribal top items.

sc: The unholy symbol is a quest item obtained upon entering the burial pyramid during the Icthlarin's Little Helper quest.
The blue villager armband is a hand slot item that can be purchased with trading sticks from Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative.
The yellow villager armband is a hand slot item that can be purchased with trading sticks from Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative.
Warped gem is a reward from the Extinction quest.
It is obtained from Vicendithas in the Effigy Incubator after visiting the Dream of Iaia.

Wushanko jacket (green).x: The green wushanko jacket is part of the wushanko outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.
